latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the tailor-pitch-by-stakeholder skill for The Challenger Sale.
- Enables users to adapt a Commercial Teaching pitch for each stakeholder role using Functional Bias Cards, following the Solae case pattern.
- Generates per-role pitch variants and a routing plan to build consensus and avoid the C-suite elevation trap.
- Designed for reps and sales teams managing multi-stakeholder enterprise deals who have already created a base pitch.
- Requires input of both the original pitch script and a stakeholder map to deliver tailored, role-specific messaging.
